intent: Add a test suite for arch_sysctl.sh and the shared harness for the optimize_arch_desktop.sh lib family, covering both sysctl-tuning functions across every branch.
scope: Non-goal: removing arch_sysctl.sh from the coverage allowlist -- see risks, the lib is not yet measurable through run_all.sh
changes: Added SYSCTL_DROPIN_DIR to arch_sysctl.sh, defaulting to the real /etc/sysctl.d so production behaviour is unchanged; it exists so tests never write to /etc, which matters because run_all.sh runs un-jailed in ci_mirror.sh and in CI

Added arch_desktop_harness.sh, the third family harness, supplying the DRY_RUN/AGGRESSIVE/TWEAKS_* globals and the apply_tweak helper that live in the entry script optimize_arch_desktop.sh rather than in any lib

Added test_arch_sysctl.sh: 23 assertions over 8 cases covering both functions' skip path, write-when-drop-in-missing path, value-differs path, sysctl-failure path, and tweak_network_sysctl's modprobe guard
Added _t_run to lib_test_core.sh: runs the subject in the current shell and captures output via a file, because command substitution forks a subshell and kcov then never registers the sourced lib

verification.evidence: All fixes lib test files passed; 21 test files green including the new one.
No findings, zero suppressions. The SC2034 on $out was fixed by exporting it, matching the existing treatment of cross-file globals in lib_test_core.sh.
Both still dated Mar 2, i.e. untouched by the suite: the SYSCTL_DROPIN_DIR override kept every write inside the throwaway tmpdir.
arch_sysctl.sh instrumented 54 lines when the function is called directly, versus 0 lines when first called inside $( ). This is what motivated _t_run.

'kcov instrumented no lines' persists through the jail even after the _t_run change, while the control lib ubuntu_perf_more.sh measures 32/32 = 100.00% in the same worktree and same jail invocation. The lib is therefore NOT yet measurable and its allowlist line is deliberately left in place.

risks: arch_sysctl.sh remains on the coverage allowlist despite having 23 passing assertions, because it cannot yet be measured through run_all.sh; the tests are real but the coverage number is unknown
_t_run changes the calling convention for future lib tests; existing test files are untouched and still green
The SYSCTL_DROPIN_DIR override adds a test seam to production code, the same seam ubuntu_perf_more.sh and arch_perf_fixes.sh already carry
rollback: git revert the commit; arch_sysctl.sh returns to hardcoded /etc/sysctl.d paths and the two new test files disappear
Re-run tests/run_all.sh to confirm the remaining 20 test files are still green
